For every payment key, independently read the expressly stated payment medium. The phrase 'in hay' states the noncash medium hay. A dollar-denominated amount does not imply cash, and absence of the word cash does not establish either cash or null. Complete null is permitted only after checking that no medium is stated for that row. Never copy a plan, purpose, or service kind as the medium.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
